title: Early-career researchers to be honored with 2026 Boeing Quantum Creators Prize
summary_en: Twelve early-career quantum researchers have been awarded the 2026 Boeing Quantum Creators Prize for work that moves the field of quantum information science and engineering in new directions.
title_cn: Early-career researchers to be honored with 2026 Boeing Quantum Creators Prize

title: Six years of SQMS: asking what limits quantum systems and building the answers
summary_en: The founding director provides perspective on the first six years of a DOE National Quantum Information Science Research Center — the Superconducting Quantum Materials and Systems Center, led by Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory.
title_cn: Six years of SQMS: asking what limits quantum systems and building the answers
